email.subject1: covering more accounts with AI ordering
email.body1:
Andrew, saw HungerRush is leaning hard into AI ordering for delivery-driven restaurants, with voice AI integrated across the platform.

A fresh product angle usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can touch before reps ramp on the message, and that is where pipeline cools. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for your region off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?

Andrew, quick follow-up for your HungerRush region.

With AI ordering as the new wedge, the target list usually outruns the team's capacity to work it. Most leaders don't know exactly how many meetings reps need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Andrew, last bit of proof for your HungerRush team.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to peer restaurant-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?

Andrew, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional pipeline without adding reps isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters and I know the quarter is busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your regional motion? I'll tailor it to HungerRush either way.
